gloss: to stand out; to excel; to surpass others

definitions.gloss: to stand out; to excel; to surpass others
definitions.explanation: To be markedly superior to others in ability, skill, or achievement. A literary and somewhat elevated expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抜|ぬ}きん{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抜|ぬ}きん{出|で}た⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a standout when it comes to math grades.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{抜|ぬ}きん{出|で}た⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: She was chosen from among many candidates thanks to her outstanding ability.

notes:
A literary verb meaning to rise above the rest. Most often appears in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form ({抜|ぬ}きん{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧) to describe an ongoing state of excellence. Originally from classical Japanese ⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧{出|い}づ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{抜|ぬ}きん{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: one's talent is outstanding
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{抜|ぬ}きん{出|で}る: to excel through ability
- ⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いて→抜く：02384_nuku⟧{抜|ぬ}きん{出|で}る: to stand far above the rest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel — more common and less literary; used in everyday contexts
- ⟦{秀|ひい}でる→秀でる：13749_hiideru⟧: to excel — literary, similar register; emphasizes shining brilliance
- ⟦{傑出|けっしゅつ}→傑出：08004_kesshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be outstanding — more formal and written; used for notable figures
